Extent order

Source: R/extent.R
extent_to_bbox.Rd

adgl takes and returns an extent as c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax), which is what vaster, ximage and graphics::par("usr") use. wk::rct() and GDAL's own bounding-box arguments use c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax). These two functions convert between them, and they are exported because a caller mixing adgl with wk needs the same conversion.

Usage

extent_to_bbox(extent)

bbox_to_extent(bbox)

Arguments

extent

An extent, c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax).

bbox

A bounding box, c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax).

Value

The same four numbers in the other order, named.

Examples

extent_to_bbox(c(100, 160, -60, -20))
#> xmin ymin xmax ymax 
#>  100  -60  160  -20 
bbox_to_extent(c(100, -60, 160, -20))
#> xmin xmax ymin ymax 
#>  100  160  -60  -20
